proposal.summary: Command injection vulnerability in the inSyncCPHwnet64 RPC service of Druva inSync Windows Client 6.6.3 allows a local attacker to execute arbitrary commands as NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM by bypassing path validation via appended directory traversal sequences.
proposal.cwe_quote: Command injection in inSyncCPHwnet64 RPC service

AV.quote: Command injection in inSyncCPHwnet64 RPC service

AC.quote: The path validation has been only implemented through a 'strncmp' function which can be bypassed by appending a directory traversal escape sequence at the end of the valid path.

Command injection in inSyncCPHwnet64 RPC service

proposal.recommended_next_step: Confirm reproducibility against the vendor-supplied version, capture exact exploit steps and RPC parameters, and coordinate disclosure with vendor to obtain a patch; advise users to stop the inSync service until patched.
